note: Hand verdicts of the session that ran the count (14 November 2026). One reader, no second reader. Each event was read with its call, the end of its result and the calls around it, without knowing which window it sits in. Keys are the first eight characters of the session id and the transcript line of the call. No command and no result text is kept here.

codes.M: a mistake of the session: it relied on something that is not there, wrote a command or arguments that could not run, acted on a state that did not hold, tripped a guard, repeated or undid its own work, or broke a check that had passed
codes.D: a defect in the work that a check or test caught, in the ordinary loop of writing and testing
codes.P: a probe or an expected failure: the answer was the point
codes.V: the environment: a timeout, the network, the PC, another session's change
codes.X: not what the kind says: the script's error
codes.Y: A3 and A3s only: the same content of the same file read again, nothing changed between
codes.S: A3 and A3s only: another part of the same file
codes.W: A3 and A3s only: the file was changed between the two reads

notes.E:harness refused: 12 of the 15 are the guard on waiting with sleep; 2 are a safety check that could not parse a harmless command; 1 is a protected-path block. All are counted as M by the letter of the scoring (tripped a guard).
notes.E:shell syntax: all 15 are a long here-document command that the shell found unterminated: the command was cut before its end marker, or quoted wrongly
notes.E:script crashed: all 15 are scripts the session wrote for the occasion; 6 stopped because the text they were to replace was not in the file
notes.E:missing command: 8 of the 10 are python, which is not on this PC's PATH
notes.E:file tool refused: 8 of the 10 are a Read of a file too large to read whole, 6 of them in one stretch of one session
notes.E:check failed: 10 of the 15 are a lint or test finding in the work (D); 3 are commands that could not run (M); 2 are probes
notes.E:other: 8 probes, 5 the environment (3 of them a shell that returned code 107 on any command), 1 mistake, 1 check finding
notes.R2: 12 of the 15 are deliberate: a test of a change against a broken or an older copy of the code, restored afterwards. 2 are text inside a here-document. 1 is a real reversal of the session's own commit.
notes.A2: 4 of the 5 are not repeats: the fingerprint of an edit ignores the text replaced, and an identical push after new commits is routine
notes.A3: all 15 are second reads of the same file; 9 another part, 4 after the session changed it, 2 the same content
notes.A3s: Y when at least half of the lines read now had been read before and nothing shows a change between. 6 of the 15 are that; 6 mostly read on into other lines; 3 read a log or an output that had been written again.
